description: Source code for IMX microcontroller mailbox (IPM) driver in Zephyr RTOS, handling inter-processor messaging and interrupt management.

methods.name: imx_mu_ipm_send
methods.description: Sends a message via IMX MU IPM, optionally waits for completion.

methods.name: imx_mu_ipm_register_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for message reception.

methods.name: imx_mu_ipm_set_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables MU IPM interrupts.

methods.name: imx_mu_init
methods.description: Initializes the IMX MU driver and configures interrupts.

methods.name: imx_mu_config_func_b
methods.description: Configures IRQ for MU instance B.

methods.name: imx_mu_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling MU messages.
